chunks: Ali ibn al-Hasan, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from some of our companions, it was narrated from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The breastfeeding that causes flesh and blood to grow is that which continues until the ribs are formed, the body is fully developed, and the soul (of the infant) is completed.

key_terms.وَيَتَمَلَّى: And the body is fully developed/mature
key_terms.يُنبِتُ اللَّحْمَ وَالدَّمَ: Causes flesh and blood to grow (indicates substantial nourishment)

ai.seo_question: What is the required duration of breastfeeding to establish permanent kinship in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Isfahani's chain of transmission clarifies the jurisprudential threshold for *radāʿ* (breastfeeding) by linking the establishment of permanent kinship to the infant's physiological maturation, specifically the ossification of bones (*yutadallaʿa*) and the completion of the soul (*tanhtahi nafsuhā*). In Shia fiqh, this definition underscores the biological basis of mahram relationships, distinguishing between mere nursing and the developmental stage that solidifies legal prohibitions on marriage.
